title: Credo (Sermisy, Missa Quare fremuerunt gentes)
desc: Claudin de Sermisy, Missa Quare fremuerunt gentes, Credo, 1556. 5 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor 1, 2. Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0008_3); edited by Vincent Besson, Marco Gurrieri, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
